title: UTIITSL PAN Portal Home
text:
Latest News 
 All applicants to apply in new PAN Forms (Application and Change Request) from 01.04.2026. Old PAN application forms (Form 49A, Form 49AA and Change Request) will NOT be accepted after 31.03.2026. As per provision of U/s 272B of Income tax Act 1961, a penalty of Rs. 10,000/- can be levied on possession of more than one PAN.Address update facility in PAN through Aadhaar based eKYC is available free of cost on UTIITSL portal. [If any NRI's PAN is still inoperative, he/she is requested to intimate his/her NRI status along with supporting documents to respective jurisdictional Assessing Officer (JAO). To know the details of JAO, click on 'Know your AO' on e-Filing portal at https://eportal.incometax.gov.in/iec/foservices/#/pre-login/knowYourAO](https://eportal.incometax.gov.in/iec/foservices/#/pre-login/knowYourAO) Applicants who all obtained **Instant ePAN** from **Income Tax Department's e-filing portal** can apply for printing of PAN card using **Reprint PAN Card** option through UTIITSL portal

♦ As per provision of U/s 272B of Income tax Act 1961, a penalty of Rs. 10,000/- can be levied on possession of more than one PAN.  
  
♦ Address update facility in PAN through Aadhaar based eKYC is available free of cost on UTIITSL portal.   
  
♦ [If any NRI's PAN is still inoperative, he/she is requested to intimate his/her NRI status along with supporting documents to respective jurisdictional Assessing Officer (JAO). To know the details of JAO, click on 'Know your AO' on e-Filing portal at https://eportal.incometax.gov.in/iec/foservices/#/pre-login/knowYourAO](https://eportal.incometax.gov.in/iec/foservices/#/pre-login/knowYourAO)   
  
♦ Applicants who all obtained **Instant ePAN card** from **Income Tax Department's e-filing portal** can apply for change/correction using Change Request application through eKYC mode from UTIITSL Portal  
♦ [ Apply for PAN, For Both Physical PAN Card and e-PAN Card, @Rs.107/-   
(Rs.1017/- for dispatch outside India) ](https://www.pan.utiitsl.com/PAN/downloadFile?FileName=UTIITSL%20-%20PAN%20Application%20Fees%20w_e_f_%2016th%20Jun%202018.pdf)  
♦ [ Apply for e-PAN Card only, No physical PAN Card, @Rs.72/-   
(e-PAN Card shall be sent to applicant's e-mail id as per Income Tax Department records)](https://www.pan.utiitsl.com/PAN/downloadFile?FileName=UTIITSL%20-%20PAN%20Application%20Fees%20w_e_f_%2016th%20Jun%202018.pdf)  
♦ [ e-PAN Card is a valid electronic mode document bearing Permanent Account Number (PAN)](https://www.pan.utiitsl.com/PAN/downloadFile?FileName=Valid%20mode%20of%20PAN%20Card.pdf "e-PAN is a valid electronic mode document")  
♦ Link your Aadhaar with your PAN using any of the following options:  
♦ [Click here](https://eportal.incometax.gov.in/iec/foservices/#/pre-login/bl-link-aadhaar) to go to E-filing website for **PAN-Aadhaar Linkage**   
♦ [ Aadhaar linking with PAN through Biometric mode is now available at UTIITSL Branch Offices.](https://www.utiitsl.com/branchlocator)  **  
♦ [ List of approved categories who all can verify PAN through online services](https://www.pan.utiitsl.com/PAN/downloadFile?FileName=PBV_Approved_category.pdf) **

Guidelines / Instructions for online payment through Payment Gateway
